_doc: The words of the part descriptions (scripts/ui/describe.gd builds them; hud_card.gd and crafting_panel.gd show them). families: one sentence of what a family does ({break_delay} and the other {braces} are filled from the game's own data). kinds: the weapon kinds of data/weapons.json. damage: its damage types. effects: one line for every weapon trait (rapid, fixed, pierce, fire, splash, pass_shields, ammo, jam, heat, breach, ammo_mult) and every key of a weapon's `effects` (scripts/combat/effects.gd), with {key} for a number of the effect, {key%} for a share as a percent, {inv} for 1 / a number, {who} for a species or two. self_room_parts: the clauses of the self_room effect. idle: tags the data carries that no code reads yet (describe.gd leaves them out, so the card never promises what the game does not do). stats: a row for each key of a part's `stats`: [label, template] with {v} for the number, or [label, template, 'skip' | 'if_not_1']. Each line is plain and dry; the lore stays in the part's blurb. tests/test_describe.gd checks that nothing in use is missing here.

families.reactor: Makes power for every part cabled to it. Without a powered reactor nothing runs.
families.helm: The ship's controls. Crew at the helm fly the ship and dodge in a fight; stand at it and press E to fly yourself. A powered helm also carries a short-range radar.
families.engine: Pushes the ship away from its nozzle, and the same thrust steers it. Every engine also gives some push sideways, so a rear pair can strafe.
families.weapon: Shoots at enemy ships from a hull mount.
families.shield: A bubble of layers round the hull: a hit costs a layer before it touches the hull. Layers come back one at a time, and a sector with none left waits {break_delay} s more.
families.medbay: A single bed that heals the patient lying in it, fast. A downed crewmate in a working medbay does not bleed out.
families.bed: A bunk. Crew rest and heal slowly on it.
families.oxygen: Makes air for the room it stands in. Needs power.
families.radiator: Pulls heat out of every part in its room. Stand it beside anything that runs hot, like a smelter.
families.fabricator: Builds parts, gear and modules from the cargo (press C). Workshop modules in its room raise its level.
families.workshop: A fabricator module. Powered in the fabricator's room, a Robot Arm makes it level 2, an Assembly Rig with two arms level 3, a Nanoforge on top level 4. A Laser Cutter adds its tool.
families.smelter: Turns scrap and ore into refined materials (steel, alloy, conductor, glass lattice) from the Smelter tab of the crafting panel (C, then Tab). It runs hot: put a radiator beside it.
families.intake: Swallows drifting debris that touches its mouth and puts it in the hold. Mount it on an outer wall, mouth to the flow.
families.tractor: Hold Q while flying: it hauls debris in range toward the nearest working intake.
families.radar: Shows contacts and their bearing out to its range. Better radars name what they see.
families.utility: A specialist part with an effect of its own. Its abilities and notes say what.
families.ram: A reinforced bow: it hits harder in a collision and latches onto the other ship.
families.ammo_rack: Stores ammunition for the guns in its room, or on its belt. Crew restock it from the cargo once it is under half full. If it is wrecked while it holds missiles, it explodes.
families.belt_drive: Powers a conveyor belt that carries ammo from the racks to the guns the belt touches.

kinds.laser: Laser: a beam that lands the instant it fires. Nothing to dodge, and a shield still stops it.
kinds.bolt: Bolt: a single shot that flies to its target. A shield or a wall stops it where it lands.
kinds.flak: Flak: a cone of pellets. Short range, so it wants the enemy close.
kinds.missile: Missile: slow and steerable. Passes through shields; a turret with point defence can shoot it down.
kinds.beam: Beam: a line of damage held on the target for a couple of seconds, hurting whatever it sweeps.

damage.kinetic: Kinetic: solid shot. Armour plating resists it best.
damage.energy: Energy: hot, focused light. Ablative plating resists it but burns away; reflective coating turns some aside.
damage.explosive: Explosive: blast damage. Scrap plate takes extra from it; heavy armour resists it.
damage.ion: Ion: aimed at systems, not the hull. Knocks shields offline for a few seconds and stuns crew in the room it hits. Neon parts suffer worst.

effects.turret: AUTO TURRET: aims and fires by itself (T toggles). {arc} deg arc, tracks {track} deg a second, {accuracy%}% accurate.
effects.fixed: Fixed gun: fires where the ship points, turned up to {gimbal} deg toward the cursor, so you aim the ship.
effects.rapid: Rapid fire: a stream of weak shots, about one a second or faster. Only a few guns are built this way.
effects.pierce: Pierce {n}: leftover damage keeps going after the first cell, through up to {n} more.
effects.fire: Fire {p}%: each shot has this chance to start a fire at the cell it hits.
effects.splash: Splash {n}: the blast also damages cells up to {n} away from the impact.
effects.pass_shields: Passes shields: ignores the bubble and hits the hull.
effects.ammo: Ammo: spends one {ammo} from the cargo for every shot.
effects.ammo_mult: Hungry: spends x{ammo_mult} the ammo for every shot.
effects.jam: Jams: {p}% of volleys seize the gun up until a crew member clears it.
effects.heat: Heat: every shot adds {n} heat to the part. A radiator helps.
effects.breach: Breach {p}%: a hit may blow a wall cell out outright.
effects.acid: Acid: eats the cell it hits at {dps} a second for {seconds} s, and creeps to neighbouring cells {spread%}% a tick.
effects.spores: Spores: the room it hits loses {o2_drain%}% of its air a second for {seconds} s.
effects.shard: Shards: splinters hit up to {splinters} neighbouring cells for {dmg} each.
effects.sonic: Sonic: crew in the room it hits are stunned for {stun_s} s.
effects.magnetic: Magnetic: pulls the enemy ship toward you.
effects.frost: Frost: the system it hits charges {slow%}% slower for {seconds} s.
effects.corrode: Corrode: the wall or door it hits takes {inv}x damage for {seconds} s.
effects.split_on_shield: Splits: a shot a shield stops breaks into {count} fragments of {damage_mult%}% damage that meet the bubble again.
effects.intercept: Point defence: turns on enemy missiles within {range} px before any ship; each shot rolls to destroy one.
effects.self_room: Back-blast: each shot {parts} in its own room.
effects.needs_operator: Needs a {who} at the gun: without one it works at x{else_mult} of its {stat}.
effects.needs_crew_in_room: Needs {count} crew in its room: with fewer it works at x{else_mult} of its {stat}.

items.ammo: Ammunition: the guns that name it spend one for every shot.
items.gear: Gear for a crew member: carried or worn, never placed on the ship.
items.special: A special item: it stays in the cargo until something asks for it.
items.material: A raw material: recipes, walls and trade spend it.

self_room_parts.fire_chance: has a {v%}% chance to start a fire
self_room_parts.shock_dps: shocks organic crew for {v} hp a second
self_room_parts.scorch_dps: scorches crew for {v} hp a second (heat-resistant crew shrug it off)

cooling_bonus: +{v} a second to every part in its room
no_knock: keep their feet in a collision
